HomePage.faq1Q: How does GrowthOS bypass iOS 14.5+ and browser ad-blocker signal loss?
HomePage.faq1A: GrowthOS uses native First-Party Server CAPI and custom domain proxy webhooks. Events originate directly from your authenticated server or verified subdomain, bypassing browser ad-blockers and Apple ITP restrictions with 100% signal delivery.
HomePage.faq2Q: How does the autonomous Cost Guardrail kill-switch work?
HomePage.faq2A: Our real-time ingestion pipeline tracks cost-per-acquisition (CPA) and click-through-rate (CTR) minute-by-minute. When creative fatigue or run-away ad bids breach your customizable risk threshold, GrowthOS automatically pauses the adset via the platform API within seconds.
HomePage.faq3Q: Can GrowthOS sync data directly to our existing BigQuery or Snowflake warehouse?
HomePage.faq3A: Yes. GrowthOS features automated SQL Mart Evolution. Raw touchpoints, attribution weights, and cohort retention rows sync continuously into your private BigQuery or Snowflake datasets for BI reporting.
HomePage.faq4Q: What is a Monthly Tested User (MTU) and how does billing work?
HomePage.faq4A: You only pay for visitors who enter an active A/B experiment or personalization variant. Aggregate passive site traffic is never billed, ensuring maximum cost efficiency.
HomePage.faq5Q: Can I review Copilot recommendations before they execute?
HomePage.faq5A: Yes. Every AI suggestion appears in your Copilot Chat and Automation Queue with full visual diffs, projected ROAS impact, and a one-click rollback guarantee. You can choose full auto-pilot or manual approval mode.
HomePage.faq6Q: Is Hebrew (RTL) fully supported across the entire platform?
HomePage.faq6A: Yes. GrowthOS is built from the ground up with 100% symmetrical bidirectional support. Every chart, drawer, table, and billboard display adjusts seamlessly between Hebrew (RTL) and English (LTR).
